errors.text: The hypothesis invents a post-solidification anneal above 900 °C as necessary for Laves precipitation, whereas the target concerns an as-cast vacuum-arc-melted alloy.
The proposed mechanical validation uses tensile testing rather than the target room-temperature compression test, making the reported mechanical response poorly comparable.
The lattice-parameter boundary is numerically inaccurate: the target contraction is approximately 3.392 Å to 3.325 Å, not 3.42 Å to merely below 3.39 Å.
